title: impatiens atrosanguinea
intro: Impatiens atrosanguinea, commonly known as the balsam, is a perennial flowering plant native to the Himalayas. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation, aiding in wound healing, and acting as a diuretic. The therapeutic actions of Impatiens atrosanguinea include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which can help alleviate pain and promote tissue repair. The bioactive constituents of this plant include balsam, resin, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
